title: Unit leadership position (canonical entity file)
description: One file per position of responsibility: data/positions/<slug>.json. These are the youth leadership roles a Scout may hold to satisfy the Star, Life and Eagle tenure requirements, which are the only place Scouting America publishes them as a list. The ranks decide which positions they accept — they are not all interchangeable, and Bugler is the standing example: it counts for Star and Life but not Eagle. So the acceptance edge lives in each rank's requirement-set, which refs `position:<slug>`, and this entity carries only the position's own identity. `audience` exists to keep the door open for adult roles (Scoutmaster, committee chair), which are a separate unpublished catalog and are NOT here yet.

name.description: Official name as printed in the requirements, title-cased for display (the source lists them mid-sentence in lower case).

audience.description: Who holds it. Every position here is `youth`; adult leadership roles are a different, unpublished catalog.

unit_types.description: Unit types offering this position: see data/vocab/position-unit-types.json. The source groups Venturing crews and Sea Scout ships under one heading and this follows it rather than splitting what the source joins — six positions (Den Chief, Quartermaster, Historian, Chaplain Aide, Outdoor Ethics Guide, Webmaster) appear under both headings.

description.description: Short original-prose description. Never verbatim requirement text.
